pages.text: Tier 2 bosses live in the Twilight Forest and Blue Skies (Frostmaw included, in Everbright). This is where Simply Swords uniques begin. Prepare in full steel or manasteel before attempting Twilight Forest.

$(bold)Naga$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Tempest$(/l), Naga Scale.$(br2)$(bold)Lich$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Soulrender$(/l), Lich Soul.$(br2)$(bold)Hydra$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Emberblade$(/l), Hydra Fang.$(br2)$(bold)Ur-Ghast$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Whisperwind$(/l) (20% — highest T2 rate), Ur-Ghast Tear.

$(bold)Knight Phantom$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Enigma$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Snow Queen$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Frostfall$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Alpha Yeti$() (Twilight Forest)$(br)Drops: $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Icewhisper$(/l), tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Blue Skies Bosses$() — Summoner, Alchemist, Starlit Crusher, Arachnarch. Each drops a unique.

$(bold)Frostmaw$() (Everbright, frozen biomes) — sleeps on the ice; strike the icicle it clutches to wake it. Drops the $(bold)Frostmaw Heart$() relic.$(br2)$(bold)Minoshroom, Bellringer, Mutant Enderman$() — $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Mjolnir$(/l), $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Storm's Edge$(/l) and $(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Slumbering Lichblade$(/l), in that order.$(br2)$(bold)Next: start with the Naga, then run /icraft codex bosses to track your 90% clear.$()
